response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.recordvault, o.ordertune FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM linked GROUP BY ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share)
